propensity: cross-fitted refitted exact Stage 30 regularized specification
censoring: cross-fitted discrete-time regularized logistic censoring model
outcome: cross-fitted arm-specific ridge regression on the IPCW-RMST pseudo-outcome, bounded to [0, 730] days
aggregation: patient-level repeated-score aggregation across 20 nuisance partitions
model_selection_rule: No learner, tuning, truncation, seed, or outcome-bound choice may be changed after protocol lock.
